subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw keep configured model costs USD-only, or define a non-USD currency contract for local model pricing and cost display?
rationale: The request changes public config and accounting semantics across schema, docs, status output, Control UI, persisted USD-named fields, telemetry, and mixed-provider aggregation; automation should not choose that contract.

options.title: Design one currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope, ISO-code behavior, mixed-currency aggregation, and display-versus-accounting semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep local model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD estimates and use provider usage snapshots for provider-reported non-USD balances.

options.title: Add display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol override while explicitly accepting that stored values and telemetry remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Design one currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope, ISO-code behavior, mixed-currency aggregation, and display-versus-accounting semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature history on usage-cost reporting and cost-summary behavior, while the decision is primarily product/accounting semantics.
